acceptance_criteria.description: One self-contained guide gives executable canonical-lease, Issue, PR, branch, lab, experiment, result, and handoff workflows.
Legacy procedures are compatibility shims or archives and no current entrypoint defines a second workflow.
Commands match current CLIs, external references are immutable and functional, and implementation limits remain explicit.
Focused tests, link checks, repository validation, lab doctor, and diff checks pass.

objective: Review and integrate the complete portable documentation cleanup with executable GitHub, branch, lab, experiment, evidence, and handoff procedures.
title: Publish one canonical MagentaBench operating guide
